title: Read-before-declare in effects, doctor test timeout, per-instance styles
why: A top-level effect reading a later const emptied the component at runtime with no diagnostic; doctor hid a test timeout behind «did not run»; window listeners were B0111; style:--c and style:background were misjudged by B0302 and B0408.
changelog: reads a `const`/`let` declared below it is an error
sets the test phase limit like `brain test`
